projects.title: Typography
projects.longDescription: Concept for two print layouts of a magazine article. The concept called for two distinct two-page layouts with images, title and subtitle. There was a requirement for at least one call out in each piece.
projects.challenge: Creating two distinct but cohesive magazine article layouts that incorporate images, titles, subtitles, and callouts effectively.
projects.solution: Developed two separate design approaches with distinct visual hierarchy, strategic image placement, and prominent callout elements that draw reader attention.

projects.title: Desktop Publishing
projects.description: Concept for Print Menu and Brochure
projects.longDescription: Concept to create a print layout of a restaurant menu and brochure that appeals to high-end clientele and includes insights into their culture while delivering on the promise of creativity, conversation, and quality.
projects.challenge: Designing premium restaurant materials that communicate upscale positioning while effectively presenting menu information and brand culture.
projects.solution: Developed sophisticated print design incorporating premium aesthetics, clear hierarchy for menu navigation, cultural storytelling elements, and brand-consistent visual language.

projects.title: Digital Publishing
projects.description: Concept for a Digital Magazine - EPUB
projects.longDescription: Concept for a digital version of a magazine in the form of an EPUB in fixed layout that will target men over the age of 35 with the goal of increasing those viewers while maintaining or increasing the loyal readers. The concept calls for a digital version of the magazine that is entertaining with interactive elements that tie to the articles, visually appealing while keeping with their brand and easy to navigate.
projects.challenge: Creating an engaging digital magazine experience that attracts new male readers 35+ while retaining existing loyal subscribers, with interactive elements and brand consistency.
projects.solution: Designed interactive EPUB layout with compelling visual design, integrated interactive elements tied to article content, maintained brand aesthetic, and optimized navigation for digital reading experience.

projects.title: Graphics & Layout
projects.longDescription: Concept to create a logo and brand identity for a client, taking into consideration the needs and requirements of the client as well as applying the psychology of design to communicate the message you intend to the client's audience.
projects.challenge: Creating a distinctive logo and brand identity that strategically communicates client values using design psychology principles.
projects.solution: Conducted brand research, applied design psychology principles, and developed a logo and brand system that effectively communicates to target audience.

projects.title: Branding
projects.description: Concept for a Logo with Branding
projects.longDescription: Concept to create a logo and brand identity for a client, taking into consideration the needs and requirements of the client as well as applying the psychology of design to communicate the message you intend to the client's audience.
projects.challenge: Developing a comprehensive brand identity that reflects client needs and communicates effectively through design psychology.
projects.solution: Created strategic logo design and brand identity system incorporating client requirements and design psychology principles for target audience connection.

projects.title: Logo Design Layout
projects.longDescription: Concept to create a logo and brand identity for a client, taking into consideration the needs and requirements of the client as well as applying the psychology of design to communicate the message you intend to the client's audience.
projects.challenge: Designing a versatile logo that works across multiple applications while using design psychology to communicate brand message.
projects.solution: Developed flexible logo design and brand identity incorporating design psychology and client requirements, applicable across print and digital media.

projects.title: Digital Imaging
projects.longDescription: My aim was to create a visually appealing and cohesive piece, which involved careful consideration of color, shape, balance, unity, and emphasis. I maintained consistency in messaging and colors to ensure that the design was cohesive across different media. Overall, I incorporated a background image that reflects the location where the adventure sports activities could take place.
projects.challenge: Creating visually cohesive digital advertisements for adventure sports with location-specific storytelling and consistent visual language.
projects.solution: Designed compelling digital ads emphasizing color psychology, visual balance, and unity through consistent messaging and imagery. Incorporated location-reflective backgrounds to enhance adventure sports narrative.

projects.title: Digital Graphic Design for Website
projects.longDescription: The concept is to create a brand that appeals to high-end clientele and includes insights into their culture while delivering on the promise of creativity, conversation, and quality. The overall display and layout was consistent with the concept. It is an image-heavy site that is interactive and uses fonts, colors and the logo from the Client. The site is responsive and the navigation is intuitive and easy to use.
projects.challenge: Designing a premium restaurant website that communicates upscale positioning while being image-heavy, interactive, responsive, and user-friendly.
projects.solution: Developed premium web design with strong visual hierarchy, strategic image use, client branding integration, interactive elements, and responsive layout ensuring intuitive navigation on all devices.

projects.title: Advanced Digital Graphic Design
projects.description: Concept to create a UX Branding Portfolio Website
projects.longDescription: The concept is to apply the principles of User Experience and KIS guidelines to a portfolio website. The concept calls for a website that is attractive, intuitive, and easy to navigate.
projects.challenge: Creating a portfolio website that demonstrates UX expertise through application of user experience principles and Keep It Simple (KIS) guidelines.
projects.solution: Designed portfolio site implementing UX best practices, minimalist aesthetic, clear information hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and accessible design that showcases UX methodology.

projects.title: Advanced Multiplatform Design
projects.description: Concept for an Outdoor Adventure Store with UI/UX
projects.longDescription: The concept is to design a website to ensure the visitor sees a consistent experience when visiting the site on different devices. The images, hierarchy and navigation will be consistent across the devices. Visitors will be able to share and access information between designs with no additional steps needed. Images, text and forms will be consistent over all the devices to provide a familiarity and comfort for the visitor. Visibility will be an important element to pay attention to by ensuring the images resize correctly and that the fonts will be visible and easy to read on smaller devices.
projects.challenge: Designing a responsive website ensuring consistent user experience, visual hierarchy, navigation, and form interactions across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
projects.solution: Developed comprehensive responsive design with consistent layout across devices, optimized images for various resolutions, readable typography at all sizes, and seamless cross-device navigation.

projects.title: UI/UX Case Study
projects.description: Website Case Study with User Research and Personas
projects.longDescription: The concept is for a website redesign and to create a user-friendly and visually appealing website that reflects the restaurant's brand identity. The new website should provide customers with easy access to information about the restaurant, including menus, hours of operation, location, and contact information. Additionally, the website needs to integrate an online ordering system that allows customers to place orders for pickup or delivery.
projects.challenge: Redesigning a restaurant website to improve user experience, address mobile issues, clarify menu presentation, and integrate online ordering while maintaining brand identity.
projects.solution: Conducted user research creating three detailed personas (Dan, John, Gabby), mapped user journeys, identified pain points, redesigned information architecture with web-optimized menus, integrated online ordering system, and optimized mobile experience.

userPersonas.name: Dan
userPersonas.title: Lawyer
userPersonas.motivation: Loves to explore local restaurants and eateries
userPersonas.values: Family-owned small businesses, quality food with fresh ingredients
userPersonas.painPoints: Finds it difficult to find restaurants with quality food, hard to coordinate meals for family, no nutrition/allergen info on menus
userPersonas.goals: Find high-quality meals with fresh ingredients, easy reservation access, easy phone access

userPersonas.name: John
userPersonas.title: Accountant
userPersonas.motivation: Love of food and need for break from everyday life
userPersonas.values: Quality food, good atmosphere, supporting local businesses
userPersonas.painPoints: Difficult to find quality restaurants, hard to coordinate meals with friends and fiance, website navigation issues, PDF menus on mobile
userPersonas.goals: Find nice restaurant with quality food and atmosphere, easy reservations, online menu access

userPersonas.name: Gabby
userPersonas.title: Graphic Designer
userPersonas.motivation: Curiosity to try new things, love of food, social media presence
userPersonas.values: Unique experiences, visual appeal, Instagram-worthy content
userPersonas.painPoints: Difficult to find new restaurants in area, especially those with local ingredients, managing weight while eating out
userPersonas.goals: Find great restaurants with quality local food, get to try every restaurant in town, find events happening in area

projects.challenge: Creating a modern charity website that demonstrates modern design trends and best practices in UX while adhering to Keep It Simple (KIS) guidelines.
projects.solution: Designed a site implementing design and developement best practices, minimalist aesthetic, clear information hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and accessible design that showcases UX methodology.
